## Summary

Describe the change, its intended behavior, and why it is needed. Do not include
sensitive data or private source.

## Required Review

- [ ] I was invited to contribute and the owner confirmed the required
      confidentiality and contributor/IP agreement is effective.
- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `docs/legal/README.md`.
- [ ] I am authorized to submit every changed file; employer/client/contractor
      obligations do not conflict.
- [ ] I identified every copied, adapted, generated, or AI-assisted part and
      recorded its provenance.
- [ ] I preserved SPDX, copyright, license, attribution, and upstream notices.
- [ ] New/changed dependencies, models, datasets, base images, Actions, or
      vendored assets have immutable evidence and updated compliance records.
- [ ] Unverified assets remain blocked; this change does not weaken acquisition,
      distribution, privacy, security, or release gates.
- [ ] No recording, transcript, identity data, embedding, profile, token,
      `.env`, cache, local path, generated output, or other sensitive material is
      included.
- [ ] AI-assisted candidate material received human IP, provenance, privacy,
      security, and test review; no AI system is named as an author/licensor.
- [ ] Package/archive/container effects were reviewed and required notices/SBOMs
      remain accurate; container publication remains blocked.

## Evidence

List relevant tests, checks, component-record changes, evidence URLs/revisions,
and artifact inspections. Use redacted identifiers only.
